description: This file defines the PostgreSQL database schema for the FitTrack application, including table creation for users, sessions, workouts, daily_metrics, goals, and notifications. It also contains seed data for demo purposes, adding initial users, workouts, metrics, goals, and notifications.
external_files: which executes this SQL file upon container startup
external_methods: from pgcrypto extension, used for generating UUIDs
calls: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto
